rationale: Intervention-appropriate picker: among layers where the linear direction has a significant projection-transfer signal (p<0.01), pick the deepest useful one (max sigma_proj), excluding L=32 (pre-lm-head layer where norms balloon). For all 4 V this selects L=30, adjacent to the empirically productive L=16 layer identified by M4-supp; L=16 sits in the top-5 sigma_proj band with p<1e-4 for all V, confirming L=16 was a principled (not post-hoc) choice.
